answer: Fresh-task bond: each identity stakes 70 credits and runs one fresh voyage per epoch with one opal-sealed cargo. The key-signed manifest and its opal seal appear once in a public log; a reused seal or a hollow voyage, no cargo moved, no countersign, forfeits the bond. Each voyage costs 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes spend 3,035,000 and tie up 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented rings fail: one seal, one voyage. An honest agent pays 38 once, bond intact.
